name: Ivette Kuyateh
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in San Diego, California
about: Ivette Kuyateh is a top-rated attorney selected to Rising Stars for 2023 - 2025. She works at Kuyateh Law Group, located in San Diego, California, and provides legal services for issues involving Estate Planning & Probate, Elder Law and Family Law to the surrounding community.
Ivette Kuyateh completed legal studies at Thomas Jefferson School of Law and graduated with the class of 2014. Ivette Kuyateh passed the bar in 2015.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
